# Purpose

To provide the WPDCS with an overview of the Data Section's activities in 2026 and progress in responding to data-related requests from IOTC meetings and recommendations from WPDCS21.

The WPDCS is invited to:

1. **NOTE** the activities undertaken by the Data Section during 2026, including technical assistance missions, workshops and data management work.
2. **NOTE** progress in addressing data-related requests from IOTC meetings and recommendations from WPDCS21.
3. **CONSIDER** priorities for further technical assistance, data reporting and data management, and provide guidance to the Secretariat as appropriate.

# Abstract

During 2026, the IOTC Data Section conducted five in-country technical assistance missions and organised three workshops to support CPCs in fisheries data collection, processing and reporting, including under the Regional Observer Scheme. The Secretariat also participated in external technical meetings and continued work on data management, reporting tools and information systems. This paper summarises the main activities and follow-up priorities, with detailed activity records, requests and recommendations presented in appendices. **[Update with verified data management, website, project and consultancy achievements before publication.]**
